newsitem.title: SPAIN: Ford Espana to partly close plants next week.
newsitem.headline: Ford Espana to partly close plants next week.

text.p: Ford Espana, the Spanish unit of Ford Motor Co said on Thursday it would partly shut down operation at its Valencia factory for five days next week, plus one more day on September 1.
"The regional authorities (Generalitat de Valencia) approved our request of permission for a maximum (layoff) of 5,766 workers for 21 days," a Ford spokesman told Reuter.
He added that next week the layoffs will affect 3,200 workers out of staff of 8,200.
"(Ford Espana) will stop some production all next week and also on September 1. In between, there will be the usual four-week holiday," he said.
He added that other plants producing car parts would remain open.
After that Ford Espana is authorised for up to another 15 days of temporary lay-offs before year end.
"We'll see how and when we use the remaining days," the spokesman said.
The temporary lay-offs were justified by an excess of production capacity, the spokesman said.

"Our production capacity is for 240,000 KA model cars a year and we forecast the manufacture of around 200,000 this year. For the production of Escort model capacity is for 460 cars per day for 220 working days in the year," he said.
Ford said that workers in temporary lay-offs won't have their wages affected as the regional government will pay around 70 percent of their wages, while Ford will cover the remaining part.
